title: Pure HERO (Omni-HERO)
summary: The Elemental HERO and Masked HERO pages both build Omni-HERO, so this is one list of HERO cards from every branch (Vision, Elemental, Masked, Destiny and Xtra) with generic staples; the Masked HERO and Favorite pages open it too. Every HERO card counts as a "HERO" for the others' effects, so mixing the branches isn't a second engine. Vision HERO Faris pulls Increase and Vyon for Polymerization, and Miracle Ejector, the 2026 one-card starter, searches EN Shuffle or an Elemental HERO Spell/Trap. The Masked HEROes and Mask Change turn any HERO into Dark Law or Atomic on the opponent's turn. Faris, Furnace and Cross Crusader lock the Extra Deck to HEROes, so the Extra Deck is all HERO.

allow.Neo-Spacian Grand Mole: Miracle Ejector's cost: it sends a Neo-Spacian from the Deck to summon itself.
